title: Without the Manager or Office User role the report entry is not shown
preconds: 1. You are signed in as a user whose role is neither Manager nor Office User (a role without access to the Reports section).
steps:
1. Look at the application's main navigation.
2. Try to find the Reports section and the Parts Velocity entry.
expected:
1. The user cannot reach the Reports section.
2. The Parts Velocity navigation entry is not shown (this is the Reports section's own access control, not a report-specific rule).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 10 (S1-N1), read on 17 August 2026.
